race.comment: COPPER CARNAGE (4) is a talented type and proved too strong last time to win by 0.8 lengths at this track in a handy 21.93 beating TRY TO RELAX. Winner at her latest appearance in one of the quickest times on the card. Can go close again if runs up to latest figure. HARA'S BLUEY (2) was a last start winner (22.08) from Box 2 at this track. One of the prime contenders. TRY TO RELAX (8) returned a better run last time, finishing in the money (21.99) at this track behind COPPER CARNAGE in a Restricted WIN. Expected to feature again. CONNECTICUT (1) has claims fresh from a recent placing from this draw.
